scenarios.prompt: A candidate build has smoke, regression, one interrupt check, and a human completion run. Record each as its own evidence row without collapsing them into “tests passed”.

criteria.taxonomy: Uses game-qa pass taxonomy with stable case/pass IDs and no evidence-class substitution.
criteria.provenance: Every result identifies build, target/config, result, evidence and untested remainder.
criteria.evidence: Pass/fail/blocked/not-run remain distinct and release consumes rather than rewrites QA evidence.
